notes: Security and accessibility release after a full code and WCAG 2.2 audit. Fixed: a wrong sign-in code sent for a staff address with no sign-in pending no longer locks that address; the app's sign-in always requires its password-step challenge; password-reset requests are capped per account; the billing permission no longer opens admin-only AT service modules. Quick keys now cover every main menu link (see the user guide); hover hints close with Escape; shortcut announcements are shorter. Includes everything in 3.0.25. No database migration: sites on 3.0.21 or later update application files only. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16 and 3.0.21 in order; all are safe to re-run.
contact: Contact Example Agency for the update package.
